##### Project general facts

PG ONE at Al Furjan is a striking residential tower brought to life by PG Properties Development, offering a stylish collection of studio to three-bedroom split-level apartments designed to enhance every aspect of modern living. Each residence is meticulously crafted to deliver unparalleled comfort and convenience, with thoughtfully designed living spaces that cater to work, relaxation, and recreation alike. The exclusive three-bedroom duplex apartments elevate the experience even further, each featuring its own private elevator, pool, and garden for a truly elevated sense of privacy and luxury.

Life at PG ONE is enriched by an impressive array of amenities crafted to meet every need in a secure and welcoming setting. Residents can unwind in the fully-equipped gymnasium and infinity swimming pool, soothe away the day in the jacuzzi, or gather with loved ones at the rooftop terrace and outdoor BBQ area with private seating, while a dedicated yoga studio and kids' pool and play area round out a lifestyle built for balance and enjoyment. A 24-hour front desk attendant and concierge service, smart home connectivity, high-speed internet, and CCTV security ensure residents are supported and completely at ease around the clock.

Inside, every home welcomes residents with a beautifully appointed lobby where sophistication meets comfort, setting the tone for the elegance found throughout. Fully equipped integrated kitchens make entertaining effortless, blending modern convenience with stylish design for everything from a quick weekday meal to a dinner party for friends. Each apartment also includes an integrated working space thoughtfully designed for professionals, allowing residents to seamlessly work, rest, and play, all within a beautifully finished home tailored to their comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a residential community located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.

The community also features several parks and playgrounds, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreational opportunities. Arjan is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and the Al Khail Road, making it easy to access other parts of the city
